siteName: Jezero Crater & Western Isidis Margin (MGS MOLA MEGDR 16 ppd)
verticalDatum: Mars Areoid (Goddard Mars Potential Model GMM3 / mgm1025)

provenance.datasetName: MGS MOLA Mission Experiment Gridded Data Record (MEGDR 16 ppd)
provenance.provider: NASA GSFC / PDS Geosciences Node (Smith et al., 2003)
provenance.instrumentOrMission: Mars Global Surveyor (MGS) — Mars Orbiter Laser Altimeter (MOLA)
provenance.processingPerformed: Direct 128×128 binary subset extracted via HTTP Range read from MEGT90N000EB.IMG (16-bit MSB signed integer elevation relative to GMM3 Mars Areoid; lbl: https://pds-geosciences.wustl.edu/mgs/mgs-m-mola-5-megdr-l3-v1/mgsl_300x/meg016/megt90n000eb.lbl).
provenance.limitations: 16 pixels/degree (~3.7 km/pix) resolves Jezero crater rim, basin floor, and Nili Fossae trough but not sub-100 m delta foreset scarps.
